label: Beginningless existential provenance: replaceable anchors versus the positive actuality input
summary: In the #1801 whole-history law/sustaining comparison (docs/notes/sustaining-vs-existential-inertia.md §7), preserved the success of actual prior bearer plus no destructive inducer plus an existential persistence law at each later time. Reused #736's whole-vector contrast and #753's verified constant_of_stationary/shift-invariance work rather than registering a duplicate selection theorem. On bi-infinite Int time an explicitly STRONGER reversible existence rule R makes any actual dated anchor E_x(s) sufficient for all of the same rigid bearer's existence stages; every particular anchor can be replaced by another. Yet R admits two independently populated histories (ever-present background b, x always present versus never present), so its common indispensable positive existential input is the disjunctive fact A_x = there is some time at which x exists, not a privileged initial moment. The equivalence A_x iff x always exists is conditional on R, and R is not a consequence of the one-way inertialist persistence P; the history assignments are structural surrogates, not complete metaphysical alternatives. An optional non-circular ultimate-completeness norm can require an account to explain existential inputs on which it essentially depends; its universal application and a proposed stronger no-constituent-sine-qua-non criterion remain disputed. The latter must not exclude ordinary two-step accounts (friction explains ignition, ignition explains flame) that explain internal intermediate inputs too. The Humean law-actuality cycle is strictly conditional on SAME fact, SAME metaphysical grounding relation and asymmetry; scientific law explanation, earlier-facts-only lawhood and independent governing laws escape the strict argument. Positive surviving rivals: primitive governing law plus basic ontology, intrinsic nature with independent existential scope, non-well-founded/holistic memberwise sufficiency, nonnecessitating reason and brute actuality. A divine source would meet the same source-actuality and no-unexplained-input scrutiny and does not follow from the scope gap. Rejected inference from temporal priority to ontological ground, from no first time to no explanation, from law multiplicity to no explanation, from globally incomplete conditional law to concurrent strict GivesAt, and from a source label to productive coverage. Rota/Pruss are identified as leads only; no new source attribution was made. The outcome adds a targeted philosophical scope audit and exact conditional premise provenance, not a Lean proof, new source claim, independent rejection item for inertia, or root closure.
blocker: The #1801 existential ultimate-completeness criterion needs independent warrant against a concrete holistic/non-well-founded account of the same A_x and a genuinely ontic governing-law-plus-material-ontology package, with nonnecessitating grounds allowed. Materialize and read any Rota/Pruss witnesses before attribution. A qualified law-versus-actuality comparison, even if ultimately favoring a global productive ground, does not establish the separate actual-concrete-source or whole-history-to-per-moment strict GivesAt bridge; 40a97664 and 2068f91c stay OPEN.
